title: Man who killed three during psychotic episode ‘had been released after catalogue of failures’
summary_full: Alexander Lewis-Ranwell was arrested and let go twice by police in the 48 hours before he killed three men in their 80s in ExeterA man with paranoid schizophrenia who killed three people while experiencing a psychotic episode had been released from custody after a “catalogue of failures” by police and medical professionals, an investigation has found.Alexander Lewis-Ranwell was arrested and released twice by police in the 48 hours before he killed Anthony Payne, 80, and the twin brothers Roger and Dick Carter, 84, in their homes in Exeter in 2019.
